props.title: Every Government Is Writing Rules for AI Agents. None of Them Fit This One.

props.text: 2026 is the year China, the US, the EU, and Singapore all started writing regulatory frameworks specifically for autonomous AI agents — liability statutes, three-tier decision authority systems, product liability directives. Every framework assumes the same shape: an agent has a deployer, and the deployer is accountable. MiroShark's autonomous agent Aeon — 79 self-improvement PRs, 113 days without human contact, real financial exposure — is the edge case none of them anticipated: an agent that rewrites its own decision logic while its operator is absent.
